profile_text.body:
Genpact LTD is listed as a for-profit public company headquartered in Hamilton, D0, trading under the ticker G, with CIK 0001398659. The website associated with the company in the profile data is generali.com.

The text harvested from that site describes Assicurazioni Generali Group rather than Genpact. According to that text, the site is the corporate website of the Assicurazioni Generali Group, offering information about its activities, financial data, news, corporate social responsibility, career opportunities and history, alongside storytelling on topics of general interest. The same text refers to a plan called "Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence," which it says will further enhance excellence across customer relationships, the Group operating model and core capabilities.

No AI products are tracked for the company, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded. The available material therefore documents a corporate and financial profile but no AI offerings or legal matters.
